name: Paradero Todos Santos
positioning: Adults-only, all-suite desert hotel between Todos Santos and Pescadero in Baja California Sur, built around a botanical garden and land-led experiences
best_for: Adult travelers who want design-led suites with rooftop stargazing nets or private zen gardens
Guests who want guided experiences across the surrounding desert, farmland and mountain landscapes

facts.text: Paradero Todos Santos is located between Todos Santos and Pescadero in Baja California Sur, Mexico.
Three airports, Los Cabos (SJD), La Paz (LAP) and Cabo San Lucas (CSL), are each approximately one hour away.
The hotel is surrounded by five distinct ecosystems.
Every suite has a private terrace, an indoor-outdoor rain shower, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, blackout drapes and an in-room safe.
The Garden Suite Hammock's design draws from Mexican hacienda heritage and Japanese spatial minimalism.
The Ojo de Agua Spa draws on the healing traditions of Mexico and the stillness of the Baja landscape.
A traditional temazcal and sound healing are complimentary for guests on the all-inclusive Paradero Unbound rate.
The Paradero Unbound rate includes breakfast, lunch and dinner, access to experiences, breathwork, sound healing and horseback riding.
The property has an infinity pool and an open-air common area called the living room, with hammocks and rattan lounge pillows.
Dining uses local ingredients from the hotel's living milpa, which helps restore Baja's native ecosystem.
The restaurant is led by chef Eduardo Rios, an alum of Pujol in Mexico City.

highlights.text: Both Sky Suites have private rooftop terraces with suspended stargazing nets.
The Saguaro Suite spans three levels on a corner lot, with views of the Sierra de la Laguna mountains, Las Palmas Beach and the La Mesa farming fields.
Architects Ruben Valdez and Yashar Yektajo designed desert-hued, brutalist-inflected buildings around a 100,000-square-foot botanical garden of endemic plants.
The ground-floor Garden Suite Hammock opens onto a Japanese-inspired desert zen garden with an artisan-made hammock.
The Ojo de Agua spa has hot and cold dipping pools and is shaded by almost 100 palm trees.

considerations.text: The hotel is not beachfront; the Pacific is a solid hike or short drive away.
Rooms have no TVs or phones, and there is no room service.
The town of Todos Santos is about a 15-minute car ride away.
